Reference vectors:
- `compact_reference.bin` and `page_header_reference.bin` were generated with
  the Python Apache Thrift `TCompactProtocol` reference implementation.
- `list_field_values_file.parquet` and `list_nested_struct_file.parquet` are
  small Parquet test fixtures from the `pyogrio` Python package, released under
  the MIT License (https://github.com/geopandas/pyogrio/blob/main/LICENSE).
  These are redistributed for test interoperability with attribution.
